## Plan

   `ComputeOption` closed sum, `InfeasibleReason` closed sum, `MarginalValueEstimate`,
   `ComputeDecisionRecord` + canonical Json codec + content address (`idp_id`),

2. Driver bind step: `decide → compute_policy.bind → envelope.check → control.decision →

   `verification.validator.verdict` rows, retry streaks, retry.attempt for the
   delegate-kind, placements/verifier/task_value from config); manifest gains

3. `hh-compute` crate (C3 leaf — nothing depends on it): re-exports + staged-variant

4. `TaskContract.task_value` (hh-verification) — sealed default via `reversibility`;

5. `hh-ontology::vocab` — `uniform` in `control.compute.policy`; `bandit`,

6. `hh-telemetry` — `scheduling.*` MetricDeclaration rows, `applies_to={native}`

7. `hh-orchestrator` + `hh-subagent` — `record.release`/refs members + child-floor

11. `hh-eval` — searched arms under `matched_cap` → `IncommensurableMatch` +

12. `hh-cli` — run_record/task_value/--extra-args CLI members per ticket.
13. `hh-compute::specs` (new module in hh-compute or hh-lab — decide at write time)

## AC matrix

- AC-1: static is byte-identical modulo ids; zero `control.compute.*` events.
- AC-2: `definition.local_refs` w/ `control.compute.policy`; bind preserves
  kind/point/owner; invalid kind/budget-widen → `PolicyInvalid`.
- AC-3: envelope-refused binding → `Unchanged` + typed infeasibility; bound decisions
  never refused.
- AC-4: every `options_supported` in `options_considered[]` with estimate|infeasible;
  rationale replayable; `compute_decision_outcome` join.
- AC-5: `rules` makes zero model calls; `cost_of_estimation` ledgered
  `harness_overhead.scheduling`; cap → `EstimatorBudgetExhausted` → Unchanged.
- AC-6: `θ_agree` over canonical hashes/verdicts; stop at agreement ≥ θ_agree or
  `k_max`; no reducer/validator → `unknown`/`infeasible`.
- AC-7: no declared parallelism/subagent targets → `undeclared_parallelism`; slices ≤
  remaining; released on `control.subagent.child.finished`.
- AC-8: `calibration_inactive` without active CalibrationRecord; positive rules fire.
- AC-10: evolution loosening (`child_floor`,`k_max`,`budget_share_cap` ↑) →
  `PolicyInvalid`/`AmendAbsent`.
- AC-11: purity — identical (decision, ctx) ⇒ identical (d', record) modulo ids.
- AC-12: lab arms match `{model_calls, tokens.output.visible, time.wall_ms, spend}`;
  searched arm under `matched_cap` → `IncommensurableMatch`.
- AC-14: recipe first-execution `{static,uniform,rules}`; `scheduling.*` metrics
  declared native-only (hosted `n/a{class}`).

## Plan vs landed

The plan above is the pre-write sketch; plan items were revised at write
time (the ticket's own clause — the plan is revisable at run time):

- Item 3 (`hh-compute` crate) → the contract lives in
  `hh-control::compute` (ADR-0299 — a C3 leaf the C0 driver cannot depend
  on would be an orphan).
- Item 5 (`hh-ontology::vocab` closed-variant rows) → variant refs resolve
  through `policy_for`; the registry ClassRecords carry the class floors
  and staged variants refuse `VariantNotAdmitted` typed.
- Items 7–8 (`hh-orchestrator`/`hh-subagent` release/refs, `hh-env` claim
  members) → no members needed: fan-out lives in the durable
  `control.subagent.*` prefix the ctx folds directly; only the child
  manifest field (`compute_policy_ref: None`) was required.
- Items 9–12 (lab/experiment/eval/cli reworks) → the recipe reads the
  arm's `compute_policy` level + `search_budget` through the existing
  `ArmSpec`/`MatchSpec` fields; the searched-arm rule landed at the
  shared `hh_budget::matchspec` layer instead of an hh-eval-side rule.
- Item 13 → the recipe builder is `hh-lab::exemplars::value_of_compute_v1`
  (the exemplar pattern of S4.x — no new specs module).

## Design rulings (ADR-0299)

- The scheduler contract lives in `hh-control::compute` next to its only
  caller — a C3 leaf crate would either be a dependency of the C0 driver
  (tier-violating) or an orphan.
- `advise` returns a typed `ComputeAdvice` record, not a `ContextItem`:
  hh-control has no hh-context dependency and `compute_advice` is a
  dialect-bump candidate kind; every C3 variant defaults to `None`.
- The `matched_cap` searched-arm rule lives in
  `hh_budget::matchspec::validate_match` — cap equality over the union of
  declared match dims and every hard-cap dim in any arm's `search_budget`;
  equal undeclared caps admit, unequal refuse `UnequalCaps` →
  `IncommensurableMatch`.
- `compute_policy`/`compute_estimator` ClassRecords are floors-only corpus
  registrations; packaged variants resolve through `policy_for`.
- `TaskValue` is a `TaskContract` member projected at seal; missing →
  `unknown`/`TaskValueMissing` → `Unchanged`, never guessed.
- A spawned child's manifest stamps `compute_policy_ref: None` — the child
  binds its own slot, never inherits the parent's.
